renderTimingScope.activeMeshes: sum of Scene before/after active-mesh evaluation intervals in this frame
renderTimingScope.mainDraw: sum of Scene before/after draw-phase intervals; excludes target draw callbacks and postprocess finalization
renderTimingScope.renderTargets: sum of every ObjectRenderer init/finish interval, including multiple targets and repeated passes
renderTimingScope.relationship: nested in frameBreakdownMs.render; inclusive intervals can overlap each other and must not be added as a whole-frame total
renderTimingScope.incompleteIntervals: unpaired intervals interrupted by renderer removal or frame termination are not counted
renderTimingScope.shaderCreation: CPU wall time between paired engine before/after shader-compilation observables; WebGL createShaderProgram submission/call time, not asynchronous GPU compilation completion
renderTimingScope.shaderPrograms: completed observable pairs, not a count of unique shaders or proof of successful asynchronous compilation; engine-wide cumulative counters include work outside the profiled scene.render call
renderTimingScope.materialEffects: effect-created notifications are not shader compilations or confirmation of effect adoption/readiness; changes compare observed effect/define identity for the same material and submesh slot, not unrelated submeshes
renderTimingScope.materialCoverage: existing scene materials and incrementally notified additions; a newly added material can create an effect before Babylon delivers its deferred added notification
renderTimingScope.details: at most 8 slowest completed target intervals and 8 material identities per frame; omitted detail counters preserve the number of other observations; variant fingerprints are non-cryptographic labels, never shader source

meshDrawTimingScope.cpu: sampled CPU wall intervals inside Scene main draw phase and its render pass; not GPU timing
meshDrawTimingScope.completed: only beforeRender -> beforeBind -> afterRender chains are timed; initial occlusion/instance-list/geometry checks before beforeRender are outside the interval
meshDrawTimingScope.preparation: beforeRender to beforeBind: material readiness, effective effect/state preparation; not a shader-compilation claim
meshDrawTimingScope.bindDraw: beforeBind to afterRender: buffer/material binding, submission, unbind and after-mesh stages; can include driver waits
meshDrawTimingScope.pairing: any unfinished attempt invalidates its mesh for this draw phase; ambiguous/nested or early-return attempts are omitted rather than paired with a later completion
meshDrawTimingScope.materials: effective material is identified by its public onBindObservable; an unobserved bind remains unknown, never inferred from a MultiMaterial container
meshDrawTimingScope.instances: native instanced batches are attributed to the rendering source Mesh; attempt counts are not instance counts or GL draw calls
meshDrawTimingScope.omissions: top 8 per dimension; up to 2048 identities and timed attempts per sample; omitted counts/CPU and incomplete intervals are explicit
meshDrawTimingScope.coverage: deferred mesh/material additions during rendering may be unobserved; current scene members are attached before sampled frames; non-sampled frames have no per-mesh clock reads
